learning_policy.daily_selection: 差異驅動＋最小功能切片；先建立可操作的基本功能項，基本流程與相應驗證通過後推進下一功能，再逐步補充細節、條件與例外；功能教學Red→完整Green→驗證；Refactor另依專案累積工程接續。阻擋流程／資料安全／必要相依性在當步處理，其餘深化工作保留原功能項，不每日全量比對
learning_policy.daily_gate: 每日教學只揭露 rust_ai_ring 精確 SHA 的 CI 狀態及待修問題；copilot_use 程式 CI、產品整合與功能驗收工作已廢除，文件交付僅核對文章、規則、JSON、連結及精確 commit 全文讀回。
learning_policy.weekly_review: At least weekly full comparison; product read-only; per-project Refactor and independent global items tracked separately; last_full_comparison only changes after actual complete success
learning_policy.dry_run: read-only product review; publish complete documentation and engineering patch/test proposals; not product validation
learning_policy.day_status: 教學已發布／程式尚待套用／功能已實作／功能正式驗收通過，依實際證據分別判定
teaching_sections: 學習大綱：目標、現況與來源
實作內容：Red／完整Green與必要補教
驗證項目：測試、證據、待完成
learning_policy.content_preservation: 已發布文章與原始commit/blob/SHA256保留；修訂使用不可變版本檔與獨立讀回，同步同一Day索引，不新增或倒退Day；封存Day正文不回寫。
learning_policy.phase_transition: 到期切換且不延後；功能未完成則原階段學習未完成，原項目跨階段補加，完工後回填原階段證據
learning_policy.functional_progress: 新增可操作功能／接通流程為每日主體；條件補充回原功能，不把單點 API／純測試／欄位及狀態碼當成完整流程。三專案並行追蹤，不預排 Day、不自動推進學習階段。
learning_policy.synchronization_judgment: 核對依「已確認需求／文章 → rust_ai_ring 精確 SHA 實作與實際呼叫者 → 匹配來源的測試／CI／功能驗證」追溯；copilot_use 僅核對文件、進度與交付證據，不要求對應程式實作、程式同步或驗收。缺證標未核實，未接通流程標部分完成，未執行明示。
learning_policy.day_revision: 已發布文章與原始commit/blob/SHA256保留；修訂使用不可變版本檔與獨立讀回，同步同一Day索引，不新增或倒退Day；封存Day正文不回寫。
learning_policy.red_green: Red is the prerequisite test for same-feature Green; preserve applied tests and provide complete Green in the same Day; distinguish expected Red from test/import/environment errors
learning_policy.day_advance: Per project: independent GitHub article commit+push, exact-commit full readback and persisted evidence, then expected-N to N+1 conditional state/manifest/index update and readback; never increment for migration/revision/makeup/rules/CI.
learning_policy.failure_recovery: Single pending record per project/Day/revision; read and deduplicate before retry; 3 consecutive failures require manual review; evidence persistence and actual verification are separate; detailed historical mechanisms 37-91 deferred
learning_policy.basic_user_flow_gate: Before selecting advanced Day topics, verify the earliest missing user-operable prerequisite using latest source/contract: Chat signup/login/session/authorized room entry; Pet create first named pet through Tauri IPC, persist in SQLite and reload; Analytics persistent admin account/password-first-login/session. Keep public room listing accessible without login where allowed; entering protected rooms requires authentication and ACL. Continue one end-to-end capability across days; do not present API, helper or status-code tests as completed product flows.
learning_policy.next_day_correction_placement: 每次核對最新程式與涉及套件；Chat／Pet／Analytics Day25（含）以前全部既有文章封存；差異只在下一Day第2節新Red／完整Green後追加舊Day更正補充；makeup_queue FIFO，每篇最多一個舊Day單元，全文讀回才結案，不因補教推進next_day。

delivery.notion_history: migrate exact originals, verify GitHub full readback, then move three-project teaching subtree to recoverable Trash; no permanent deletion
delivery.commit_policy: one independent article commit and push per project/Day; never batch multiple projects or days
success_gate: full exact-commit GitHub readback: all sections and code; blob SHA and SHA256 evidence
conditional expected-N to N+1 state+manifest/index synchronization on latest branch/blob SHA
delivery.concurrency: check active runs and branch/blob SHA; expected_sha lease; no overwrite

learning_policy.project_refactor_section: 同篇獨立Refactor段落，正文詳列修改前後、逐檔完整修改單元、caller／module／依賴接線、完整測試與舊斷言承接；patch為附件，不以連結代替教學；各案與全專案分開。
learning_policy.global_refactoring: 全專案另列docs/engineering/README.md獨立項目，不塞入三案、不重複計功

initial_activities_and_roaming.creation_transaction: profile and both initial activities commit or roll back together
initial_activities_and_roaming.walk: active implies outside and roaming permitted subject to runtime pauses
initial_activities_and_roaming.sit: active implies outside and roaming prohibited
initial_activities_and_roaming.walk_sit_switch: mutually exclusive atomic update; do not insert duplicate activity records
initial_activities_and_roaming.unexpected_both_active: sit takes precedence; persist walk=false, retain sit=true; remain outside; roaming prohibited
initial_activities_and_roaming.cage: stop every activity for the selected pet only
initial_activities_and_roaming.priority_write_failure: stop roaming and report persistence failure; do not claim normalization completed
